result.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?
result.markdown:
For most small online stores, I'd recommend **Stripe** as the best all-round payment processor, with **PayPal as an additional checkout option**\.

However, if you're selling in the UK, there are a few particularly good options worth comparing.

## Best payment processors for small businesses (UK)

![Stripe Logo Download (SVG, PNG, EPS, PDF) | PixelBrands](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/aVtuLxJXV9DmtEmg9b45Apl_aIYsif99dM-GHSfkXYZDC4tFOhFvFlTrHocFw_PqD4iGlfn8TyGj8Knz3iEfgQ88Gl1qbf-qVS8yq3s_dga8IuVvdS85dQWTHuxQAfDBHQSn4bvLAWea6XSgqDlmrU-sz5LlptntGZmOFqqabVil8_uydbbIqAvaqwgrj-k8?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Stripe**

(Best overall)

- Around 1.5% + 20p for standard UK cards.
- No monthly fee on standard pricing.
- Excellent integrations with WooCommerce and other platforms.
- Supports Apple Pay, Google Pay and subscriptions.

Best for: Most new and growing online stores.

[Stripe website and pricing](https://stripe.com/gb)

---

![Download the PayPal logo in PNG y SVG | LogosDown](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/MAzkiJ1YuDnyj2FyYAyszlEHA_k7S0XqFuDRhbVDc0cICTj1-X82VJgt7N8vcRcKsONlo3HvF0Pe2MUizAJnEXGjXwhkQKSdT9w8dASkeKU2hONBc_K0UGh46cKL9ey1QEsmTJtnMOjwtp9k8flMfotUdye-2o09Vcb_X37Fr_RqbfMx2vNQ-Z2QRLli3zQI?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. PayPal**

- Widely recognised by online shoppers.
- Easy to integrate.
- Customers can pay using PayPal or supported card options.
- Fees can be relatively high.

Best for: Giving customers an additional trusted payment option.

[PayPal Business](https://www.paypal.com/uk/business)

---

![Shopify Payments w Polsce – jak działa, koszty, wdrożenie, zalety - Adtrip](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/tzlxg0Y9z5dRoMa7puRQ5gUF-G3hcQ7FEcuVco38BEG917LKXepufVl9cw-FwTKDdqoHqkcHNs202c43Bsg-KXxlvnrYPNEJMBSIYJqLREQ2DlgIvAOQgkKyUCOU_zdRd59gIwC2e-5cs0YCLvv_6mYa-9FiK4qFkvvkawoheALPlNv3AkWQkvUMElw-UVk8?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Shopify Payments**

- Integrated directly into Shopify.
- Simple payment management.
- Supports major cards and digital wallets.
- Avoids Shopify's additional third-party transaction fee.

Best for: Stores already running on Shopify.

[Shopify Payments](https://www.shopify.com/uk/payments)

---

![square-logo](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/1usVU99QTc623Z1qK0LnerrVUCFuaCZRY9kzKFoWI_Gdr9NcpX1vWKOmILymiErxn6ndDcZZ0Or5-PjPVYj_lTK1K9NB9Q8Cck3TogeQjE13w7S0OC_soTbxUb84o9oqvCcpbffi8RgWQf3ncfxvUqtopiXbgd9lTiIMfcExXBRU8XgKgcPu-V2QhGDsZYzn?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Square**

- Straightforward setup.
- Online and in-person payment processing.
- Useful sales and inventory tools.
- No standard monthly payment processing fee.

Best for: Businesses selling online and in physical locations.

[Square UK](https://squareup.com/gb/en)

---

![Mollie pinautomaat kosten (2026) · gratis vergelijken](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/D57_7d7oSy02s6yl1zjAav-Yxgf4LUZZPYDHYzFt_wNqCHlBqkrhAHplhYfBTJOJy91u1bEQYVbEZXh_gEzRP8VoyGIrNDZVtuNQGJCvwJQrSLcgSZ7d7a0ve45WpqW-VHK_GV5JgM8myiK1AujLCh4qHlURg2gBe2EoWYpui5Qphgo8QfSPgrRjtevRCmLH?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Mollie**

- Competitive European card processing rates.
- Supports multiple European payment methods.
- No standard monthly fee.

Best for: Stores selling across the UK and Europe.

[Mollie website](https://www.mollie.com/)

Indicative UK pricing; actual fees depend on card type, payment method, plan and transaction location. Check providers' current pricing before signing up. ## My recommendation

| Your situation | My choice |
|--------|--------|
| General small online store | Stripe |
| Shopify store | Shopify Payments |
| WooCommerce store | Stripe |
| Selling internationally | Stripe or Mollie |
| Online and physical shop | Square |
| Want customers to pay via PayPal | Add PayPal |
